statements.t: This strategy aims to reposition the Company’s funding mix by lowering deposit costs and improving net interest margin over time.

Management reevaluated the existing collateral based on updated “as-is” appraisals and due to the expected duration of the resolution process, recognized a charge-off of $26.1 million from the previously established reserve during the three months ended March 31, 2026.
The Company's CECL models incorporate historical experience, current conditions, and reasonable and supportable forecasts in measuring expected credit losses.

On a long-term basis, the Company’s liquidity will be met by changing the relative distribution of its asset portfolios (for example, by reducing investment or loan volumes, or selling or encumbering assets).
